title: 真题演练 · 时态综合
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 时态综合。

questions.q: He ___ English since he was ten.
questions.analysis: since + 过去时间点,用现在完成进行时。

questions.q: By next Friday, I ___ this book.
questions.analysis: by + 将来时间,用将来完成时。

questions.q: She ___ the piano for two hours before dinner.
questions.analysis: 晚餐前持续弹了两小时,用过去完成进行时。

questions.q: I ___ my keys; I can't find them anywhere.
questions.analysis: 强调结果与现在联系(找不到钥匙),用现在完成时。

questions.q: This is the best film I ___ ever ___.
questions.analysis: 最高级/序数词后接现在完成时。

questions.q: 判断对错:I am living here since 2015.
questions.analysis: 应改为:I have been living here since 2015.。since 引导的时间段用完成时态,不用现在进行时。
